name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Fail-safe 5wCal selection/return build. Use the first tap coordinates as the double-tap date target, strengthen selected-date feedback with a two-pixel blinking frame and 100 ms buzz, stop reinitializing Bangle.setUI on calendar return, and wrap selected-date return-to-Orbit so any exception is logged and automatically falls back to the real-time Orbit display instead of leaving a navy screen.
